set.body: Implement docs/plans/terminal-workspace.md. A local viewer launched with connect --view or view shares observations with the agent via workspace snapshots and independent activity cursors. Scope: project/root identity, bounded file and log browsing, job-artifact links, remote-only observation, visible staleness, and terminal lifecycle. Reuse WP8a; do not duplicate its journal or observer. Completion requires V1-V4 and exact-candidate UI/live evidence. Implementation remains unstarted.
